description: This file implements a voice conversation bot with speech recognition, classification, and response generation, utilizing multiple LLMs, frame processing, and transport mechanisms.

classes.name: AudioAccumulator
classes.description: Buffers user audio until the user stops speaking, then creates an LLMContext with the audio frames.

classes.name: CompletenessCheck
classes.description: Checks if the user has finished speaking based on classifier responses and triggers notifications.

classes.name: LLMAggregatorBuffer
classes.description: Buffers output from the transcription LLM for the bot output gate.

classes.name: ConversationAudioContextAssembler
classes.description: Adds the latest message from the audio context to the conversation's LLM context.

classes.name: OutputGate
classes.description: Buffers output frames until a notifier triggers, then flushes frames and updates context.

classes.name: TurnDetectionLLM
classes.description: Pipeline that manages transcription, classification, and response generation for user turns.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes individual frames for various classes, handling audio buffering, classification, and gating.

methods.name: _idle_task_handler
methods.description: Handles idle timeout for completeness checking.

methods.name: wait_for_transcription
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until a transcription is available.

methods.name: _gate_task_handler
methods.description: Main loop waiting for notifier events to flush buffered frames.
